arguments.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, o.status, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Fonderia Sarti S.p.A.') AND o.id = 65;
